overview: Thrawn stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a grand admiral. A brilliant Chiss tactician who studied his enemies' art and nearly crushed the Rebellion with methodical precision. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, Thrawn's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
